div.span:
OVERDUE IS NOT A STORED STATE.
Derived as status in
borrowed or partially_returned
AND due_at earlier than now.
Index borrow_status_due_idx serves it. Two entry paths, on purpose. Direct create flips Equipment to borrowed inside the same atomic block. create_pending only validates availability, so the equipment stays available until an admin approves.
draft and partially_returned are in TicketStatus and in the filters, but no view writes them. Only seed_data.py sets partially_returned, for the demo set.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span:
lost and damaged are in LineStatus, in
has_outstanding and in the overdue mail
query. ReturnItemSerializer offers them
but is imported only by tests, so no
production path writes those two rows. Every write also appends a BorrowStatusLog row: from_status, to_status, changed_by, note.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span:
update_status is IsAdminUser and writes
an EquipmentStatusLog row.
Ticket-driven flips do not. A line item may instead be adhoc, equipment_id NULL plus a free-text name and quantity, for chairs, tables, keys. Those touch no Equipment row at all.

svg.text: BorrowTicket lifecycle and the two status machines it drives
